headword: {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}

definitions.explanation: Work that primarily requires physical strength and effort, such as construction or farming.

examples.japanese: {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}は{体|からだ}がきつい。
{若|わか}いころは{肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}で{生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てていた。
examples.english: When I was young, I made a living through manual labor.

examples.japanese: {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}が{中心|ちゅうしん}の{仕事|しごと}から{頭脳|ずのう}{労働|ろうどう}に{転職|てんしょく}した。
examples.english: I changed from a job centered on physical labor to intellectual work.

notes:
Work that primarily requires physical strength and effort, such as construction, farming, or warehouse work. A compound of {肉体|にくたい} (physical body) and {労働|ろうどう} (labor). Often contrasted with {頭脳|ずのう}{労働|ろうどう} (intellectual work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}に{従事|じゅうじ}する: to engage in physical labor
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}{者|しゃ}: manual laborer
- {重|おも}い{肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}: heavy physical labor
- {肉体労働|にくたいろうどう}が{中心|ちゅうしん}: centered on manual labor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頭脳|ずのう}{労働|ろうどう}: intellectual labor; mental work — the opposite
- {力仕事|ちからしごと}: physically demanding work — more colloquial
- {単純作業|たんじゅんさぎょう}: simple repetitive work — not necessarily physical
